# Halo Meister 0.2.2

## Latest Steam runtime support

- Added full live-tools support for the current Steam build of Halo: Campaign
  Evolved while preserving support for the current Xbox/Game Pass build.
- Corrected the Steam runtime tag arena lookup, fixing invalid
  `ReadProcessMemory` failures while scanning loaded mission tags.
- Updated the native Blam bridge to recognize both current retail DLL identities.
- Verified all 21 guarded native bridge entry points and their instruction
  prologues against the supplied Steam DLL.
- Tightened build-profile matching to require the exact DLL SHA-256, PE timestamp,
  and image size before runtime access is enabled.
- Retired only the superseded July 28 Xbox DLL catalog entry; the current,
  previously working Xbox profile and native layout remain unchanged.
